summary: John's 8th-great-grandmother (if the Doll link holds); of the Schuch family of Ulmet.
bio:
Mother of Johann Casper Doll. Her Schuch kin apparently sailed with Casper in 1739: 'Christ. Shook, 48' on the Samuel list; a Johann Christian Jacob Schuch b. 4 May 1690 at Ulmet, d. 1768 Springfield Twp, Bucks Co. (GEDBAS 1402009472, from an Ancestry tree).

Her marriage entry of 2 Mar 1704 at Ulmet calls her Sara, daughter of Joh. Peter Schuch ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch calls her Sara Margaretha Schuch, born at Rathsweiler on 11 Jan 1686 (baptized 28 Mar), daughter of Hans Peter Schuch (1661-1747) and Anna Maria Käppel ([R4-S2]). It also has her emigrating: she died at Tohickon, Bucks Co., Pennsylvania, on 3 Apr 1760 and was buried at Bedminster. The source for that is a Historical Society of Pennsylvania burial card for 'Sarah Doll', whose image came back empty ([R4-S2]). If correct, she came over with her son Caspar's group in 1739, and women were not listed on those ships. She would then have lived near the Tohickon Reformed congregation, where Caspar's daughter Anna Catharina was baptized in 1757. The site's 'Anna Sara' should probably be 'Sara (Margaretha)'.
